name: nuvio
description: Modern and lightweight CSS framework providing a good but small foundation for all types of web applications using the Flexible Box Layout module (Flexbox)

scripts.build: npm run build:full && npm run build:base
scripts.build:full: npm run build:full-auto && npm run build:full-prefer && npm run build:full-light && npm run build:full-dark
scripts.build:base: npm run build:base-auto && npm run build:base-prefer && npm run build:base-light && npm run build:base-dark
scripts.build:full-auto: sass --style=expanded --no-source-map src/main-full-auto.scss dist/nuvio.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map src/main-full-auto.scss dist/nuvio.min.css
scripts.build:full-prefer: sass --style=expanded --no-source-map src/main-full-prefer.scss dist/nuvio-prefer.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map src/main-full-prefer.scss dist/nuvio-prefer.min.css
scripts.build:full-light: sass --style=expanded --no-source-map src/main-full-light.scss dist/nuvio-light.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map src/main-full-light.scss dist/nuvio-light.min.css
scripts.build:full-dark: sass --style=expanded --no-source-map src/main-full-dark.scss dist/nuvio-dark.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map src/main-full-dark.scss dist/nuvio-dark.min.css
scripts.build:base-auto: sass --style=expanded --no-source-map src/main-base-auto.scss dist/nuvio-base.css && node scripts/purge-vars.js dist/nuvio-base.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map src/main-base-auto.scss dist/nuvio-base.min.css && node scripts/purge-vars.js dist/nuvio-base.min.css
scripts.build:base-prefer: sass --style=expanded --no-source-map src/main-base-prefer.scss dist/nuvio-base-prefer.css && node scripts/purge-vars.js dist/nuvio-base-prefer.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map src/main-base-prefer.scss dist/nuvio-base-prefer.min.css && node scripts/purge-vars.js dist/nuvio-base-prefer.min.css
scripts.build:base-light: sass --style=expanded --no-source-map src/main-base-light.scss dist/nuvio-base-light.css && node scripts/purge-vars.js dist/nuvio-base-light.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map src/main-base-light.scss dist/nuvio-base-light.min.css && node scripts/purge-vars.js dist/nuvio-base-light.min.css
scripts.build:base-dark: sass --style=expanded --no-source-map src/main-base-dark.scss dist/nuvio-base-dark.css && node scripts/purge-vars.js dist/nuvio-base-dark.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map src/main-base-dark.scss dist/nuvio-base-dark.min.css && node scripts/purge-vars.js dist/nuvio-base-dark.min.css
